title: Advanced Dances of the World
description: Courses designed for the advanced continuing study of the dances and historical context of a particular culture or ethnic form: Afro-Cuban, Spanish, Balinese, Japanese, Latin, etc. Specific topic will vary from quarter to quarter. May be taken for credit two times. Prerequisites: TDMV 142 or TDMV 143 or TDMV 144, or consent of instructor.
